semantics.clock: Sample s on each rising edge of clk; outputs decode the registered water level and direction history after the edge. Inputs changing between edges do not change outputs.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority over s, sets level below s[0] and all four outputs high. No power-up initialization is specified before a reset edge.
semantics.history: At either intermediate level, dfr is 1 when the level before the latest sampled level change was lower, otherwise 0. Hold dfr on unchanged level. Compare any legal level jump directly against the previous sampled level.
semantics.invalid_sensors: Physically inconsistent patterns 010,100,101,110 have no specified behavior; implementation holds prior level and direction.

numeric.sensor_order: s[0] lowest, s[1] middle, s[2] highest; only thermometer patterns are physically legal
numeric.arithmetic: Unsigned level comparisons only; no rounding, saturation, accumulation, or overflow arithmetic

verification.oracle: Independent integer water-level and last-change direction model, with table-based nominal flow outputs
verification.directed: Reset with every sensor pattern; synchronous reset timing; rising/falling changes, unchanged-level history retention, endpoint overrides, all 16 legal level-to-level transitions including skipped levels
verification.sequences: Enumerate all length-five sequences of legal levels, plus repeated reset while active
verification.timing: Check outputs before and after rising clock edge, including mid-cycle sensor/reset changes
verification.tools: Explicit dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012 -Wall, finite compile and simulation timeouts; internal simulation watchdog

specification_ambiguities.issue: Physically inconsistent sensor patterns are unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Hold current state; do not claim benchmark correctness for these inputs

specification_ambiguities.issue: Exact sampling edge is not explicitly stated beyond synchronous reset and state machine
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use conventional positive-edge synchronous Moore state machine

specification_ambiguities.issue: Intermediate wording may appear counterintuitive for reservoir control
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Follow literal instruction: supplemental valve asserted on rising-level changes
